subject: koalas
one_liner: A real-time social network for koalas, built around the four hours a day they are awake.
brand_voice_notes: Bellow talks like a growth team that has accepted its users are unconscious 83 percent of the time and decided this is a moat. Posts are bellows. Liking is clinging. The timeline arrives once a day at dusk. Every metric is reported flatly, including the ones that are zero. No exclamation marks, no emoji, no urgency, because nobody is awake to feel it.

hero.h1: Post for four hours. Sleep for twenty.
hero.sub: Bellow is a real-time social network for a user base that is asleep 83 percent of the day. The timeline refreshes once, at dusk, and then it is over until tomorrow.

features.title: The Dusk Drop
features.blurb: The whole day's timeline lands at 18:40 in a single batch. You read it from a fork in a tree, half awake, and you do not reply. Engagement is flat at zero percent and holding steady.

features.title: Sleep Posting
features.blurb: Bellow listens while you sleep and turns your snoring into posts. Our models have identified eleven distinct snores. Nine of them are about leaves.

features.title: Leaf Verification
features.blurb: The green check goes to any account that eats 500 g of eucalyptus a day. It was the only verification standard the board could stay awake through.

demo_screen_concept: The Bellow timeline at the moment of the Dusk Drop. Three-column app: a left rail (Home, My Tree, Snores, Leaf Check, Profile), a centre feed of koala bellows with photo avatars, leaf-check badges, timestamps and an action row (Grunt, Re-bellow, Cling with live counts), and a right column of trending leaves with daily consumption figures. Above the feed: tabs for Awake now / Asleep / My tree that filter posts, a 24-hour sleep-schedule bar with a draggable clock that shows the four waking hours in orange, and a compose box capped at 40 characters that locks itself with a 'you are asleep' notice whenever the clock is outside waking hours. A 'show raw snore' toggle swaps sleep-posted bellows between their transcription and the original snore. One bellow carries an attached photo of a koala asleep in a tree fork.

images.rationale: Hero skipped because the Swiss-modernist direction is typographic and the 24-hour bar is the hero device. Demo is a social feed, which is photo-shaped: the three testimonial headshots double as feed avatars, and one budget slot went to an attached photo on a feed bellow (koala asleep in a tree fork). 4 of 4 used.

design_direction.style: Swiss-modernist sleep-schedule grid, overcast eucalyptus daylight mode. The page is a strict International Typographic Style poster for a social network: a visible 12-column grid, flush-left ragged-right type, huge numerals, and one structural motif borrowed from a shift roster. Explicitly absent, because the last seven entries used them: candlelight, foil rules, dotted menu leaders, ruled worksheets, stickers, red pen, highlighter swipes, glossy prints, staples, SMPTE bars, pegboard, aisle signs, shelf tags, cork, pins, tape, pulp cells, grade stamps, vent holes, physical-material staging of any kind. Also absent: dark mode, glassmorphism, blur, gradients behind body text, rounded cards. Four motifs carry the page. (1) The 24-hour bar: a horizontal strip of 24 cells, 20 filled in sleep green #2F5D50 and 4 left open with an orange #E0643A outline, used as the hero device, the section divider and the pricing header. (2) The grid line: 1px hairlines in ink at 14 percent mark the column grid behind the hero and every section top carries a 2px ink rule with a numbered label (01, 02, 03) in mono. (3) The giant numeral: statistics are set enormous in the display face, weight 800, tight tracking, with a small mono caption underneath. (4) The awake orange: #E0643A is rationed to waking-hour cells, the primary CTA and the highlighted tier. Corners are 0 everywhere except avatars, which are perfect circles. Headings are Bricolage Grotesque 800, sentence case, -0.035em. Body is Public Sans 17px/1.6. Times, counts and prices are JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.

fonts.body: 'Public Sans', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

design_direction.archetype: Social network launch page, Swiss poster composition: hero with oversized headline over a 12-column hairline grid and the 24-hour bar, numbered sections, stat band of giant numerals, testimonial row with circular headshots, three-tier pricing table with a schedule-bar header.
design_direction.motion_vocab: Schedule motion only. The 24-hour bar fills cell by cell left to right on load at 30ms per cell, the awake cells pulse their outline once, sections slide up 12px on reveal with a timeout fallback, buttons shift 2px on press. 180ms ease-out, all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Typographic hero, no image. Headline spans columns 1 to 9 at clamp(3rem, 8vw, 7.5rem). Under it, the 24-hour bar runs full width with hour labels 00 to 23 in mono, the 4 waking hours (18 to 21) outlined orange and captioned 'awake'. Sub copy sits in columns 1 to 6, the CTA and a mono status line ('next Dusk Drop in 06:12:40', live countdown) in columns 8 to 12.
